'''2007 Worlds Day 2 Lee Edwards LS Plead My Case To The Senate''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Lee Edwards]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 2). The sheet's deck title is ''Desai's LS Senate''.

Four card lines on the sheet match no card title. They are left unlinked and marked ''(unknown card)'' in the list below, and they are listed under Missing data at [[Talk:2007 Worlds Day 2 Lee Edwards LS Plead My Case To The Senate]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Lee Edwards]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Plead My Case To The Senate / Sanity And Compassion|Cor-L-pleadmycasetothesenate.gif|label=Plead My Case To The Senate}}
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
